description: FREE lite Base token verdict for a token contract address. Runs the same 10 checks as token_verdict but returns top-line results only: the GO / HOLD / BLOCK decision, the one-line verdict, 0-100 score, A-F grade, risk level, and the top 3 flag titles — detail is capped (no per-check evidence, no market block). Use this to triage whether a token deserves the full token_verdict report, or call token_verdict directly for the complete evidence-backed scan.

address.description: Base token contract address (0x-prefixed, 40 hex chars), e.g. 0x4ed4E862860beD51a9570b96d89aF5E1B0Efefed

name: token_verdict_lite
